This site uses the existing MLC quantization; it does not fine-tune model weights.
The original artifact bytes are split into smaller, checksummed transport files.
The browser reassembles the same original model shard bytes before inference.

Runtime: WebLLM 0.2.85 / MLC AI
Runtime source: https://github.com/mlc-ai/web-llm
Runtime license: webllm-LICENSE (in this directory)
Source library bytes retain their original notices; application integration,
download progress, checked chunk transport and response validation are separate
files authored for this educational prototype.
